title: Launch last gate OK
summary: Changed the Launch compact Last gate to show OK/No issue when launch history exists, while leaving detailed history-review evidence available in the History panel.
reason: The compact Last gate was presenting historical command-review evidence as a current yellow At Risk issue even though that gate is non-required and backend preflight remains the authority for current launch safety.
behavior_before: A prior launch command with review history made the compact Last gate render At Risk with a Last issue note.
behavior_after: A visible prior launch command makes the compact Last gate render OK with a No issue note; no-history still renders Needs Evidence.
tests_added: Updated tests/webview/test_webview_browser_launch_queue_readiness_smoke.py to assert the compact Last gate renders OK/No issue with existing launch history.
